verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Rainforest offers pricing control (buy-rate, no revenue split) and data ownership within its managed PayFac model, but nothing describes a formal path or mechanism for a platform to graduate from Rainforest's managed model to its own registered PayFac status while keeping the same integration. Missing for 10: any documentation of a registered-PayFac graduation tier, sponsorship-to-direct-registration transition process, or 'without replatforming' migration guarantee.
